1.title: Stage 1: finalist with axonal SK density zero (single change)
1.prediction: If axonal SK carries the growing trough-to-threshold delay: axonal SK current at trough+6 ms is zero by construction, the late trough-to-threshold delay shortens by more than 12.8 ms at 0.19 nA (from about 81 ms at cycle 13) and by more than 12.8 ms at 0.27 nA, and the count rises above 14 and 37. Early cycles (cycle 2: 34.76 / 16.37 ms) change by less than 12.8 ms because the SK gate is below 0.003 there. Widths, peaks and troughs 1-3 stay within the stage-0 bands (width 0.221 +/- 0.006 ms, peak <= 22 mV, trough within 1 mV).
1.rejection: The late delay does not shorten beyond 12.8 ms at either input although the SK current is removed; or spikes are lost; or the soma enters depolarisation block (voltage held above -20 mV for more than 5 ms). Any of these rejects axonal SK as the direct path of the late delay under the finalist settings. A count rise without a human-ward change is recorded as a mechanism observation, not as a promotion.
